name: What should I do immediately after a rear-end collision?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after a rear-end collision?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a rear-end collision, prioritize safety. Check for injuries and move to a safe location if possible. Exchange insurance and contact information with the other driver. Document the scene by taking photos of vehicle damage, road conditions, and any visible injuries. Report the incident to the police and seek medical attention for any pain or discomfort, even if it seems minor. Avoid discussing fault at the scene. Contacting a lawyer soon after can help ensure your rights are protected and evidence is properly collected.
acceptedAnswer.description: After a rear-end collision, ensure safety, exchange information, document the scene, report to the police, and seek medical attention. Contacting a lawyer early can protect your rights.
